_doc: Complexity ladder L3 (the L2 geometry with a reversing inflow (half-sine systole, reverse lobe 0.40-0.52 s, parabolic profile scaled to the flow rate), three cycles); the U-bend gallery mesh configuration with 12 cells across the span. Invoke with: python run_patient.py ladder_L3 --config cases_input/ladder_L3/config_gallery_coarse_span12.json Outlet backflow damping: betaT 0.3 (default) and betaN 0.3; with betaN 0 the fine mesh collapsed at t = 0.468 s in the reverse lobe (normal inflow spike in the wall/cap corner cell of the outlet, 24 Nov 2026).

case_info.description: Ladder L3: the L2 geometry with a reversing inflow (half-sine systole, reverse lobe 0.40-0.52 s, parabolic profile scaled to the flow rate), three cycles; 12 cells across the inlet span
case_info.source: OpenCardioFlow complexity ladder, 23 Nov 2026; cases_input/ubend/config_gallery_*.json with the geometry and inflow changed

geometry._doc: reference_radius_strategy='max' (default) anchors the background-mesh sizing to the largest vessel. For the single-tube ubend this is the inlet (27.4 mm). On a multi-branch aorta, switch to 'min' if you need every branch resolved to the cells_across_span target.
